card: Changes CWallet::CommitTransaction and interfaces::Wallet::commitTransaction to return broadcast errors via util::Expected instead of returning void. This allows interfaces such as the QML GUI to inform users when a transaction has been rejected instead of falsely claiming 'Transaction sent' (bitcoin-core/gui-qml#1008). Existing wallet RPC and Qt widget callers ignore the returned error to maintain existing behavior.
changed_since_previous: Initial description was evaluated without patch data; the full patch confirms the signature refactoring across interfaces and the addition of unit tests in `wallet_interfaces_tests.cpp` and `wallet_tests.cpp`.

enables: bitcoin-core/gui-qml update to report broadcast errors to users (gui-qml#1008)
Follow-up PR propagating errors from commitBumpTransaction

evidence: PR description: 'The QML GUI shows "Transaction sent" even when the node rejected the transaction, because CWallet::CommitTransaction() only logs the rejection and returns void' (bitcoin-core/gui-qml#1008)
problem: Frontends relying on `interfaces::Wallet::commitTransaction` cannot know if a transaction was accepted into the mempool because `CWallet::CommitTransaction()` only logged errors and returned `void`. Consequently, interfaces such as the QML GUI report 'Transaction sent' even when the node rejected the transaction.

risk.why: A mistake in transaction submission error handling or mempool state tracking in CWallet could cause wallet transactions to incorrectly fail or become desynchronized from the node.

scope_notes: Modifies public interfaces across `interfaces::Wallet`, `interfaces::Chain`, and `interfaces::Node`, refactoring `BroadcastTransaction` signatures and updating all internal invocation sites.
summary: Updates wallet commit and transaction broadcast interfaces to return an `Expected<void, TransactionBroadcastError>` instead of `void` or error codes with separate output strings. Introduces `TransactionBroadcastError` pairing a `TransactionError` code with an untranslated message, removes `TransactionError::OK`, and adds a `SUBMISSION_SKIPPED` code for transactions that the wallet chooses not to relay. Existing callers such as RPCs and the Qt widgets interface currently discard the result to preserve existing behavior.
